subject: General Studies
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Promoting Global Understanding in CBSE Class 11 General Studies.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 11 General Studies (502), Unit-4: Promoting Global Understanding covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
